title: tandoori chicken skewers
text: Welcome back to my series where I show you cooking Indian food is actually easy. Let's make some smoked and dirty chicken skewers. They're perfect for meal prep. Holy shit, that's good. You gotta make this one. I start by marinating cut up chicken thighs with a few spices, lemon juice, dried fenugreek leaves, ginger garlic paste, yogurt and oil. As always, you can find the full recipe for free on my website or down below. Now, I make these all the time, but the first time my friend tried it, it was instantly, where'd you get these? Now, the key is to marinate these for at least a day, but an hour will work. Pack it tightly onto skewer so it stays juicy, then air fry at 400 for 15 minutes, flipping halfway. While that's cooking, heat up a piece of coal directly over the stove. Once it's done, add a bit of oil, cover with the chicken for at least 5 minutes, and now it's time to enjoy.
